verdict.rationale: Figma Make is itself an AI agent that builds apps, so serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The only MCP evidence (docs-16) describes Make connecting out to external tools as an MCP client, which belongs to the separate MCP-client story and cannot be credited here. Nothing in the pack shows Make running as an MCP server or exposing a first-party MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
